scope: Unprompted pretrained phoneme consistency on97 original training WAVs from the frozen38-triplet acoustic review queue; no wake training, automatic relabeling or quality advancement.
limits: This learned phoneme model was already observed to make errors on these synthesizers. Predictions, edit-distance order and cross-intent predicted-string collisions are not verified pronunciation, actual waveform collisions, human wake recall or true phone endpoint labels. The deliberately selected correlated97 sources/38 triplets cannot rank TTS engine quality or estimate corpus-wide label errors. No labels, splits or checkpoints change. No validation/final scoring, API keys, network inference, speaker, microphone, board/USB, firmware/OTA, production board, original PCM speed or single I2S/AEC/AGC/FIFO modification. Full Hi ESP acoustic recognition/FAR/latency,P4 resources and long-call/reconnect stability remain unproven.
